name: MegaMan's attack's Sword bit, BN6's
why: As the Wind bit (above): BN6 keeps an attack's second element as a bit of its variables' +2, 0x80 a Sword chip's by its record's +6 (the table at 0x080129E4), ORed in by its chip route (0x080129A6) and chip use (0x080126F6); BN4 none. ProtSoul's WideSwrd, BN6's own by name, used charged: bn4_soul_prot_chip at t64
